The Slider, in motion.

The same seven stages as the interactive player — drawn the way the systems explainers do it: clean, flat components joined by pipes, with packets moving between them in real time. Every orange dot is a contact on its way through the architecture, from the first phone call to the self-organizing AI2 mesh. Each component is an icon with its short name underneath and a numbered pointer — the legend under the diagram says what every number is.
